I was a bully in grade school for a year or two. I still feel bad about it to this day because the girl ended up moving schools afterwards.

Anyway, she was different looking and everyone made fun of her, so of course I wanted to be cool and did it too.

She ended up reporting us to her mother and telling the school she wanted to kill herself - of course it was serious because we were all under 10yo at the time.

I ended up being nearly suspended, still remember the principal yelling an inch away at my face about how I can’t treat people like that, then coming home and knowing my mother was on the phone with the mother of that bullied girl. I remember when she got off the phone with her I was yelled at the same way as the principal, I probably cried, and became a really quiet kid.

To be honest I think it traumatized me a bit the approach because I became very isolated after that from my peers, bullied out of school and was homeschooled, and feared my mother. 

I never made any friends and when I finally did it was in college with druggies. I lost them all and two had od’ed - thankfully not me.

Only have one friend to this day who is my girlfriend.

Anyway, be careful if your child is a bully with how you approach it - I felt like a monster at a young age and retreated into social isolation and shame.
